written_by: development agent from the five catalog photos, before the first measured run; evaluator-only input (the author receives the request notes only)
identity_features: Single wrap-around shield lens spanning the whole front, with a shallow notch at the centre bottom for the nose; the lens is tall in the middle and tapers toward the temples
Brow bar only: a black frame along the top edge of the lens, no lower rim; the lens is exposed below and at the outer edges
Strongly wrapped front: in the side and angled views the lens curves well back toward the temples, following the face

Lens finish: mirrored Prizm coating with a colour shift from pink/magenta to green/teal depending on the angle; the lens looks reflective, not transparent, in the front photo; a small Oakley 'O' icon and 'PRIZM' lettering near the outer edge
Thin black temples, straight, with a white Oakley 'O' logo near the hinge and rubbery grey-black ear socks at the ends
Black nose pads on a small bridge piece under the brow bar centre; the bridge does not cross above the lens
Colour: black, matte to satin finish on the brow and temples

conditions.photos: front, back, left, right and one three-quarter angled view (held out from the author)
